chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the menstruating woman: for how long does she practice precautionary waiting? He said: She practices precautionary waiting for one day, or two days, or three.

key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she practices precautionary waiting beyond her usual period

ai.seo_question: How many days does a menstruating woman practice istizhar according to the hadith of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the menstruating woman and the period of precautionary waiting (istizhar). It states that she may observe precautionary waiting for one, two, or three days.
